digest.component_or_area: Backend port / Jira DC transport adapter
propositions: DC transport raises JIRAError which is not caught by existing CORE exception handlers expecting urllib.error.HTTPError, causing updates to fail instead of degrading gracefully
outbound_differ._safe_get_issue fails to classify remotely-deleted DC issues as _DELETED because JIRAError does not match its 404 detection logic, breaking deletion detection silently on DC
Backend port declares no exception contract, forcing CORE reconciler modules to depend on transport-specific exception types (urllib leak to vendor-neutral code)
BackendHTTPError subclassing urllib.error.HTTPError allows existing CORE catch clauses to match without modification while the DC adapter translates JIRAError at the boundary
DC transport must translate JIRAError to BackendHTTPError preserving HTTP status code at the single choke point (_with_connection_retry) so all downstream callers receive a neutral contract type
